proyecto.vision.text: The UAMOTORS racing project takes shape in "OP", our flagship single-seater. This vehicle is the result of an engineering cycle that spans conception, design, manufacturing, and testing under international standards. The goal behind "OP" is to build a reliable race car optimized for novice drivers, prioritizing low operating costs and highly manufacturable designs.
proyecto.objetivo.d1: Prioritize driver integrity and the vehicle's structural safety at all times.
proyecto.objetivo.d2: Ensure the consistency of integrated systems to pass technical inspections.
proyecto.objetivo.d3: Implement a robust data acquisition system (telemetry) to serve as a technical foundation for the team's future development.
proyecto.sistemas.text: The development of the OP is divided into interconnected technical areas working together to maximize performance:
proyecto.sistema.text.cha: Structural design and dynamic validation of the space frame chassis and bodywork. Its goal is to guarantee driver safety and vehicle integrity.
proyecto.sistema.text.dyn: Responsible for on-track vehicle behavior through the precise tuning of the suspension and steering systems, ensuring agile, stable handling and mechanical grip.
proyecto.sistema.text.pwr: Integration, thermal management, and calibration of the powertrain based on a high-performance motorcycle engine. Designing intake, exhaust, and drivetrain systems to optimize power delivery and on-track traction.
proyecto.sistema.text.ele: Programming of the ECUEngine Control Unit, integration of embedded systems and dynamic sensors. Responsible for vehicle electronics, power delivery, and data acquisition (DAQ) for technical feedback.
proyecto.sistema.text.aer: Airflow optimization using CFDComputational Fluid Dynamics to generate efficient downforce, enhancing race car stability without compromising performance through excessive drag.
proyecto.herramientas.text: To guarantee the precision of every component, the team utilizes industry-standard tools for design and simulation:
proyecto.herramienta.des1: Extensive use of Solidworks for mechanical modeling.
proyecto.herramienta.des2: Structural and fluid analysis using Ansys.
proyecto.herramienta.des3: Process planning with strategic partners to ensure the technical viability of the components.
proyecto.fsae.text: Formula SAE (FSAE) is the most globally recognized student engineering competition, governed by the technical standards of the Society of Automotive Engineers (SAE). It is not simply a speed competition, but a platform where over 100 universities validate the design, manufacturing, and financial management of a high-performance race car.
proyecto.criterios.estaticas.lista:
• Engineering design: Technical defense of design decisions before industry expert judges.

  • Cost analysis: Evaluation of resource efficiency and manufacturing processes.

  • Business Presentation: Presenting a market strategy and business viability for serial production.
proyecto.criterios.dinamicas.lista:
• Acceleration: Evaluation of power and traction over a 75-meter straight.

  • Skidpad: Measuring cornering ability and lateral grip on a figure-eight track.

  • Autocross: Assessing handling and agility on a tight, winding circuit.

  • Endurance: A demanding 22 km race to test overall reliability and efficiency.

proyecto.timeline.item3.title: FSAE México (February 2027)
proyecto.timeline.item3.desc: Participation in FSAE México with the physical prototype and dynamic tests.
proyecto.timeline.item4.title: FSAE Michigan (May 2027)
proyecto.timeline.item4.desc: Goal of qualifying and competing in the international event in the United States.
